about_the_game:
This downloadable content includes a single avatar fully compatible with Animaze, featuring both ARKit-based and standard facial tracking support.

Liss is a mysterious and powerful warrior from a forgotten civilization, brought to life in the digital world. Her sharp gaze and futuristic armor hint at secrets hidden beyond the stars.

Every part of Liss can be customized. You can change her colors, add props like crowns, glasses, or weapons, and shape her look to match your style. Liss has smooth facial movements, dynamic expressions, and fluid animations that make her perfect for any virtual adventure.

Liss is ideal for streaming, online meetings, gaming, or any virtual event where you want to stand out with strength and elegance.

Features

  • Facial Animations
    Includes a standard set of facial animations for use with the Mediapipe tracker, as well as an ARKit-specific set designed for iPhone tracking. Both options provide smooth, expressive facial performance.

  • Color Customizations
    Every part of the avatar supports extensive color customization, offering users full creative freedom to match their personal style.

  • Props Attachment Slots
    Equipped with slots for a wide variety of props, including:

    • Hat

    • Mustache

    • Earphones

    • Glasses

    • Holdables

    • Carryables

  • Hand Tracking
    Supports all 70 hand animations for detailed and natural hand movements.

  • Full Body Tracking
    Compatible with Axis Neuron for full-body tracking, ensuring dynamic and lifelike performance.

  • Special Actions
    Features special actions retargeted from Animaze’s mannequin, enhancing the character’s versatility.

Includes 2 backgrounds with light setup: Celestial Hall and The Core Gate

This avatar content is developed by a third-party art team and will only be available in the Steam Live Service version of Animaze,  to Steam users who have purchased this DLC. It will not be included by default in any standalone historical snapshot of Animaze, and it will not be available outside of Steam.
